item.title: Openring-rs: a webring for static site generators written in Rust
item.description:
📝 ⛓ openring-rs A tool for generating a webring from Atom/RSS feeds. openring-rs is a tool for generating a webring from Atom/RSS feeds, so you can populate a template with articles from those feeds and embed them in your own blog. Decrease logging verbosity -h, --help Print help (see more with '--help') -V, --version Print version Using Tera templates The templates supported by openring-rs are written using Tera.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/lukehsiao/openring-rs
